items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Wouldn't be anybody like Bob Haggard, the bass player with Bob Crosby.

ctx.x: Yeah, he made, this number we played so fast, that music, swing that music, and all, and he arranged numbers like that. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da. Swing that music.
Wouldn't be anybody like Bob Haggard, the bass player with Bob Crosby.
I wouldn't bother, no, I wouldn't bother. Yeah.
